title: Tiny, cute light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- glow halo -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='26' fill='#FFE680' opacity='0.18'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='19' fill='#FFE680' opacity='0.25'/>
    <!-- glass bulb -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='15' fill='#FFF2A8'/>
    <ellipse cx='45' cy='34' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.75'/>
    <!-- filament -->
    <path d='M46 44 Q50 50 54 44' stroke='#FF9E3D' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- neck of bulb -->
    <rect x='44' y='54' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFD24D'/>
    <!-- screw base -->
    <rect x='43' y='59' width='14' height='3.5' rx='1.75' fill='#9AA6B8'/>
    <rect x='44' y='62.5' width='12' height='3.5' rx='1.75' fill='#C3CCDA'/>
    <rect x='45' y='66' width='10' height='3.5' rx='1.75' fill='#9AA6B8'/>
    <!-- tiny bottom contact -->
    <rect x='47.5' y='69.5' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7C879A'/>
    <!-- cute face -->
    <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#8A5A00'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#8A5A00'/>
    <path d='M46 43 Q50 46 54 43' stroke='#8A5A00' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>
</svg>
